svg.title: Viticulturist — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as viticulturist, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: Six separate grapes taper into a bunch beneath a short vine stem and small leaf. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap and round glasses.
